title: 23 supplier links declare location ENTSO (registered as ENTSO-E); two declare CH for GLO/RER suppliers
observation: 23 exchanges declare the supplier location `ENTSO`; no dataset is registered as ENTSO, 25 as ENTSO-E, and every one of the 23 suppliers exists as ENTSO-E. Two more exchanges declare `CH` for suppliers that exist only as GLO / RER (`Disposal, concrete, 5% water, to inert material landfill`; `Direct air capture system, sorbent-based, 100ktCO2`). An importer linking by name + location drops all 25 silently; one linking by dataset number does not. BAFU confirmed this by email on 12 October 2026 and announced a correction for its next release; community-fixes [patch 0002](https://github.com/sentier-dev/bafu-community-fixes/blob/053c799a4d3e129747f47d6775ea88647c0bec78/src/bafu_community_fixes/patches/p0002_supplier_locations.py) uses the suppliers' locations until then.

provider_response.public_summary: Confirmed the 25 supplier locations; to be corrected in the next release.

validation_scope: Re-measured on the release files; the patch changes a location only when a supplier with the new location exists.
next_action: Verify the 25 locations in the next BAFU release; then mark upstream-fixed and retire patch 0002. F14 and F16 are the same class but not part of patch 0002.
